name: Rune Duelist
lore: A human swordsman who stitches glowing runes into every step of a duel.

primary.name: Inscribed Cut
primary.description: A close sword cut deals 24 damage and leaves a rune at your feet. Keep up to 3 runes for 10 seconds; every third cut gains 10 damage.

secondary.name: Runestep
secondary.description: Teleport to your oldest attack rune within 480 units, damaging enemies along the clear route for 28. If that rune is unreachable, make a short forward step instead.

special.name: Sigil Court
special.description: Connect your runes into a glowing court for 2.5 seconds. Enemies inside take 10 damage every half-second. Missing runes are formed around you.

passive: Lingering Script: your planted runes remain for 5 extra seconds.

technique.name: Long Runestep
technique.description: Runestep can return 50% farther, for 25% less route damage.

final_technique.name: Twin-Script Return
final_technique.description: Two large returning runes deal 30 per leg. Replaces the rune domain with a mobile aimed attack, without domain protection.

attack.name: Twin-Script Return
attack.description: Two large returning runes deal 30 per leg. Replaces the rune domain with a mobile aimed attack, without domain protection.
